# Italy Aerial Orthophoto

> A STAC catalog for the Italian national aerial orthophoto mosaic: every AGEA
> flight from 2022, 2023 and 2024, merged into one seamless country-wide RGBA
> grid and published as a cloud-native Zarr v3 array that reads directly from
> object storage. This catalog is a mirror: it holds metadata only and points
> at MindEarth's bytes on Source Cooperative.

One collection, one item, one Zarr store. The data is a raster array, so there
is no SQL path and DuckDB is the wrong tool. Read it with `xarray` over an
S3-style Zarr store, anonymously, from `eu-central-1`.

Key facts, all taken from the store's own metadata or measured against it on
2026-10-31:

- Array `rgba`, dims `(band, y, x)`, `uint8`, level-0 shape `(4, 2899968, 2244608)`.
- CRS EPSG:3857, 0.597164283559817 m per pixel at level 0, 12 pyramid levels.
- Bands are `red`, `green`, `blue`, `alpha`. Alpha is a coverage mask: 0 means
  no AGEA imagery.
- The y axis descends, so slice it `slice(ymax, ymin)`.
- The stored array is padded; the valid extent is `(4, 2898688, 2230272)`.
- About 25 percent of the country-wide grid carries imagery.
- Values are rendered 8-bit display tiles, not calibrated reflectance.

## Docs

- [Catalog agent guide](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/stac/AGENTS.md): how to read the catalog, and the traps that return wrong answers rather than errors.
- [Collection agent guide](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/stac/agea-orthophoto/AGENTS.md): band table, pyramid-level table, and worked Python run against the published store.
- [Catalog README](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/stac/README.md): what is here, licence, provenance.
- [Collection README](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/stac/agea-orthophoto/README.md): the dataset in full, including the resolution and radiometry caveats.

## STAC

- [Root catalog](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/stac/catalog.json)
- [Collection agea-orthophoto](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/stac/agea-orthophoto/collection.json)
- [Item italy-mosaic-2022-2024](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/stac/agea-orthophoto/italy-mosaic-2022-2024.json)

## Data

- [Zarr v3 store](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/italy-aerial.zarr): the mosaic itself, media type `application/vnd.zarr; version=3; profile=multiscales`.
- [Zarr root metadata](https://data.source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial/italy-aerial.zarr/zarr.json): multiscale layout, WKT2, tile matrix set, AGEA source endpoints. 97 KB, and enough to confirm the grid without reading imagery.

## Optional

- [Upstream repository](https://source.coop/mindearth/italy-aerial): MindEarth's Source Cooperative repository, the origin of the data this catalog mirrors.
- [MindEarth Zarr viewer](https://mindearth.github.io/zarr-viewer/?p=rgb-multiscale&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdata.source.coop%2Fmindearth%2Fitaly-aerial%2Fitaly-aerial.zarr): browser preview of the RGB multiscale pyramid.
- [Geoportale AGEA](https://geoportale.agea.gov.it/): the original 20 cm orthophotos, for work that needs full source resolution.
